statement: AMD Instinct MI355X systems are live and serving HUMAIN customers in Saudi Arabia, with up to 250 MW planned from 2027 and up to 1 GW by 2030.
why: A live sovereign-AI deployment moving from announcement to production is a concrete multi-year merchant-GPU design win outside the hyperscalers.

impact.mechanism: A committed multi-hundred-megawatt sovereign build locks in accelerator, CPU and networking purchases across several years.

evidence.excerpt: Next phase of buildout: up to 250 MW of AI infrastructure planned beginning in 2027.

confidence.basis: Official AMD investor-relations release, the primary source for this design win.

dispersion: Capacity is stated as up to 250 MW and up to 1 GW; ceilings rather than contracted amounts.
